## About
Frisco Lawn and Power Equipment is a dealer for lawn maintenance equipment, chainsaws and generators, as well as a parts store and a service/repair facility. We stock models for the homeowner and commercial equipment as well, and we are the parts, equipment and service supplier to most of the professional landscapers in the area.
Our technicians are factory trained and certified. They work on everything from handheld equipment and walk mowers to riders and zero turn mowers. We take the time to get to the bottom of your problem, find the best repair, and answer your questions about it.
The owners, Perry and Gay Lee Prindle, are committed to quality service for every customer. We serve Frisco, Plano, Allen, McKinney, Prosper, Celina, Little Elm, The Colony and surrounding areas, and we hold a 4.3 rating from 213 Google reviews.

## Services
- Blade Sharpen/ Oil Change Package: Available year round for 21"- 22" walk mowers. Usually we can do it while you wait. ($39.00 + tax)
- 13-Point Maintenance Service: For 18"-22" walk mowers: sharpen blades, change oil, replace spark plug and air filter, flush and drain the fuel system, check belts and blade engagement, and pressure wash under the deck. Discounted to $90.00 + tax in late fall and early winter. ($120.00 + tax)
- 8-point Maintenance Service: For hand held/ 2-cycle equipment from Stihl, Echo and Shindaiwa: replace spark plug, air filter and fuel filter, flush and drain the fuel system, lube linkage, clean the spark arrestor and pressure wash. A discounted price runs in late fall and early winter. ($80.00 + tax)
- 20-Point Maintenance Service for Zero Turn Radius mowers: For Scag, Toro and Stihl zero turns: sharpen and balance blades, change oil and filter, check brakes and hydro fluid, sync drive controls, level the deck and more. Zero turn mowers require an appointment. (Approx. $350.00 - $450.00 + tax)
- Engine Service/ Repair: For any brand of mowing equipment with a name brand engine: Briggs & Stratton, Honda, Kohler and Kawasaki. Won't start, running rough, broken recoil starter, blowing smoke.
- Complete Hand Held Equipment Service/ Repair: Service and repair for Stihl, Echo, Shindaiwa and Honda gas-powered hand held equipment.
- Complete Zero-Turn-Radius Service/ Repair: Service and repair for Toro, Scag and Stihl zero turn mowers. Please call to make an appointment.
- Pick-up and Delivery: Available for riding mowers and zero turn radius mowers. ($170.00 ($85 pick-up, $85 delivery))

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for riding mower service?
A: Yes. Riding mower and zero turn service requires an appointment, so please call the shop first. We encourage getting riding mower work done in the fall or winter to avoid delays in the spring.

Q: Can I wait while you sharpen my blade?
A: Usually, yes. The Blade Sharpen/ Oil Change Package for walk mowers can usually be done while you wait. One reviewer had the blade on his Toro sharpened and was in and out in minutes.

Q: What does it cost to fix equipment that won't start or runs rough?
A: For a walk mower, hand held equipment or a pressure washer that is running rough, hard to start, won't rev up or surging, repairs typically cost between $140-$190 ($45.00/ $85.00 deposit).

Q: Should I call or come in?
A: During the busy part of the season we may have trouble answering all your calls, especially on Saturdays. Coming to our facility gets you better service.

Q: Do you sell used equipment?
A: During the winter months of November through February, we have pre-owned lawn care equipment available for various brands.
